scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @editor/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter server --filter web run dev
scripts.build: tsc -b editor/server && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b editor/server && pnpm --filter web --filter pie-chart --filter graph-editor run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:editor: tsc -b editor/server && pnpm --filter web run typecheck
scripts.build:editor: tsc -b editor/server && pnpm --filter web run build
scripts.ci: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:claude-hooks && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:pdf-to-svg && pnpm run test:graph-editor:py && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.ci:editor: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run typecheck:editor && pnpm run test:editor && pnpm run build:editor && pnpm run e2e:editor
scripts.ci:pie-chart: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run typecheck:pie-chart && pnpm run test:pie-chart
scripts.ci:graph-editor: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run check:ci && pnpm run typecheck:graph-editor && pnpm run test:graph-editor && pnpm run test:graph-editor:py
scripts.ci:pdf-to-svg: pnpm run check:comments && pnpm run test:pdf-to-svg
scripts.ci:offline: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$m = Get-Module -ListAvailable Pester | Sort-Object Version -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $m) { Write-Error 'Pester module が見つかりません。Install-Module Pester -Force -SkipPublisherCheck で導入してください。'; exit 1 }; Import-Module Pester -RequiredVersion $m.Version -Force; if ($m.Version.Major -ge 5) { $c = New-PesterConfiguration; $c.Run.Path = 'offline/lib/verify.Tests.ps1'; $c.Run.Exit = $true; $c.CI = $true; Invoke-Pester -Configuration $c } else { Invoke-Pester -Script offline/lib/verify.Tests.ps1 -EnableExit } "
